scope: Metric reproduction from saved record-level predictions, already evaluated public MD reference labels, and fixed training thresholds; not re-training, blind testing or experimental validation. Five seeds share evaluation cluster pools and may share records. No raw full database, PoLyInfo or restricted experimental labels included.
redistribution_review: Source licensing and attribution are maintained by the release owner in root THIRD_PARTY_DATA.md. The software license does not replace source-data terms.

PolyOmics.target: MD simulated thermal conductivity near 300 K and 1 atm, W/(m K)

OPC.scope: 579 previously evaluated labeled V records; postcompetition public computational cohort

input.preserved_order: Within each group, exactly the saved prediction-file evaluation order; stable sorting breaks Top-K ties by this order.

metric_definitions.macro_mae: mean of within-cluster mean absolute errors; OPC only
metric_definitions.tail_mae: mean absolute error for y >= frozen training-set nearest-rank q95; evaluation labels do not set threshold
metric_definitions.precision_at_k: overlap of stable descending top-k prediction and top-k truth indices, divided by k; classifier variants rank by class_score
metric_definitions.seed_aggregation: mean and sample SD (ddof=1) of seed-specific metrics; not the error of ensemble-averaged predictions
metric_definitions.dtype: Ridge predictions restore original IEEE float32 from saved shortest decimal before float64 scoring; all other packaged predictions scored as float64
metric_definitions.precision_display: Precision values multiplied by 100; SD in percentage points. Expected rounding follows manuscript cell precision.
